_comment: Kaggle ISLR (asl-signs) signer-disjoint split. Generated by src/data/kaggle_islr_loader.py from the participants present in train.csv. ``train_signers`` go into the training pool; ``val_signers`` are held out for in-domain val_acc; ``held_out_signers`` are the primary signer-generalization metric (val_signer_acc). Edit by hand to rebalance.
